title: uninstalling a symlinked widget removes the destination, not the symlink
line: Uninstalling a widget that is a symlink now removes only the link and leaves the folder it points to untouched.
explanation: KPackage::PackageJob::uninstall sets the package path, and Package::setPath stores the canonical path with symlinks resolved. The uninstall thread then ran QDir::removeRecursively on that path, so for a symlinked widget it deleted the real source folder and left a dangling link. The change passes the unresolved path to the job and, when it is a symlink, removes just the link with QFile::remove.

commits.message:
PackageJob: Don't delete the target of a symlinked package on uninstall

Uninstalling a widget that is a symlink deleted the folder the link points
to, because the package path has symlinks resolved. Now the unresolved path
is passed on and only the link is removed, also when updating over a link.

BUG: 508717

media.caption: Master: after uninstalling the symlinked My Dev Widget, its source folder ~/src/my.widget is gone and the dangling link stays
Fixed: the link is removed, ~/src/my.widget and its files are intact
Master: uninstalling the symlinked widget from Add or Manage Widgets
Fixed: same uninstall from the sidebar, together with a normally installed copy

review.text: Solid fix in the right KDE Frameworks layer (kpackage) for a critical data-loss bug: Package::setPath() canonicalizes symlinks, causing PackageJobThread::uninstall() to recursively delete the symlink target directory instead of unlinking the symlink. Passing the unresolved uninstallPath and removing symlinks via QFile::remove() in removeFolder() safely protects the target on both uninstall and update-over-symlink while preserving normal directory removal and the empty-pluginId safeguard. Verified via Widget Explorer, kpackagetool6 (-r/-i/-u), and passing kpackage autotests.

reviews.text: Solid fix in the right KDE Frameworks layer (kpackage) for a critical data-loss bug: Package::setPath() canonicalizes symlinks, causing PackageJobThread::uninstall() to recursively delete the symlink target directory instead of unlinking the symlink. Passing the unresolved uninstallPath and removing symlinks via QFile::remove() in removeFolder() safely protects the target on both uninstall and update-over-symlink while preserving normal directory removal and the empty-pluginId safeguard. Verified via Widget Explorer, kpackagetool6 (-r/-i/-u), and passing kpackage autotests.

Right root cause, fixed in the right layer (KF kpackage). Package::setPath canonicalizes the path, so PackageJobThread ran removeRecursively on the symlink target. Passing the unresolved uninstall path and unlinking a symlink in removeFolder fixes both the uninstall and the update-over-a-link paths (installPackage calls uninstallPackage on the unresolved targetName). Real package directories and tempdir cleanup behave as before. The before/after shots clearly show the data loss and that it is gone, ctest passes, and kpackagetool6 -r/-i/-u were checked. Small optional improvement: a symlink case next to the existing uninstall test in autotests/plasmoidpackagetest.cpp would protect this data-loss fix.
